juan-lopez-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Founded in the 1870s by the Spaniard whose name it carries, Juan López keeps a small, loyal following; Selección No. 1 and No. 2 form the core, joined in 2021 by the 52 x 170 mm Selección Especial for the brand's 150th year. All leaf comes from the Vuelta Abajo. The robusto shows earth, roasted nuts and cream, with coffee taking over at the close.

thirds.notes: An intense start of earth, roasted nuts and cream, with dry cedar, leather and a peppery spice on a lengthening finish.
The body eases as the creaminess peaks, with dessert-like sweetness and a spicy almond; some smokes show fruit and floral touches.
Coffee steps forward with earth and roasted nuts; reviewers differ on whether the power rises again or softens.

juan-lopez-cuba--edicion-regional.description: Juan López is among the brands most often chosen for Ediciones Regionales, with about twenty by 2021, each from the house blend in a size outside the regular range. Examples include the Selección Superba for Great Britain in 2016, 54 x 150 mm, and the Gran Patagón, 52 x 135 mm, presented in 2023 for Argentina, Chile and Uruguay.

thirds.notes: In the Superba, chocolate and wood lead, with grass, citrus and pepper, and cedar on the retrohale.
Chocolate stays in front as the citrus sweetness grows; past the midpoint pepper and grass build.
Grass now shares the lead with chocolate, balanced by citrus sweetness, pepper and a little wood.
